title: Wire the illustrative placement and area allocation into the worked scenario and the report: building_alternatives[].placement + [].area_allocation + geometry.floor_plates emitted via three_way_document.py/first_option_results.py/geometry.py; the building-not-placed sentence clears and the kit draws plates (readers.py unedited, keys on floor_plates); the area-allocation register calculation entry + calc docs with step P8; the G-5 benchmark regenerated from the corrected engine; NB-03 rev 4, NB-04, NB-06 rev 4 and the NB-01 contingency; G-13 status cells (P-6.2 part B).
objective: Behaviour-identical on 1.4.0. (1) Emit building_alternatives[].placement and [].area_allocation into the document via a thin _apply_placement / _apply_area_allocation in three_way_document.py using the Part-A modules (build_placement / build_area_allocation); the existing conditional version bump already declares 1.5.0. (2) geometry.py emits real floor-plate outlines (3 plates) once a placement exists, replacing the ruling-W5 not_available floor_plates; this is what makes readers.building_not_placed (which keys on floor_plates; readers.py is NOT edited and stays forbidden) stop emitting the not-placed sentence and lets the kit adapter draw plates. (3) first_option_results.py gates the placement/footprint lines on whether a placement was emitted, so pages 5, 6 agree on every document (1.4.0 byte-identical). (4) The review register gains an area-allocation CALCULATION entry (register.json + REGISTER.md + HISTORY.md), with docs/zoning-rule-review/calculations/calc-area-allocation.md and calc-first-placement.md and their evidence/*.txt, each carrying step P8 (placement-building-b.json) as the worked example; no human verdict (G-11). (5) Regenerate the whole G-5 benchmark from the corrected engine (never hand-edited): recorded_215_16_northern_journey.json gains placement + area_allocation + drawn floor_plates; the DXF and site-plan SVG snapshots regenerate; update every pinning consumer only where the engine output moved. (6) NB-03 rev 4, NB-04 and NB-06 rev 4 revised with independent readings (G1); if a research_status changes, update the README status cell and RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md index prose in the same task (G-13; M5-T172 is the W28 owner); the NB-01 contingency fires because three_way_document.py is in NB-01 code_paths (code-identity revision + a G1 agent delta review). All expected values come ONLY from placement-building-b.json / overlay-reading.json / real-lot.json and the law, never a program run; the label is exactly Illustrative; nothing is called complies/buildable/optimal/feasible.
business_reason: D-094 R043/R044/R058/R076/R082/R088/R091/R092/R094/R096 and the owner's 2026-10-14 review (source-021): page 5 leads with limitation paragraphs and page 6 shows a three-floor stack with no footprint fitted to the site, and the area-allocation illustration is absent. The next milestone (R143) is a scenario placed on the actual site with reconciled calculations and clearly identified remaining constraints. This task puts the placement and the allocation into the one document that feeds page 5/6, the website and the PDF; M5-T173 then draws the dimensioned footprint, the section and the two-zone illustration.

The work order's blanket 'web forbidden' is overridden for exactly the two web benchmark-consumer tests here (recorded at G0); any other web red routes out.

RISK B3 (one-owner serialisation): this task holds the G-5 benchmark, the G-11 register and the G-13 records whole; it runs strictly after M5-T169 and M5-T170 release them (W28). It must NOT run in parallel with either.

RISK B4: the setback/street-wall/rear-yard values the placement names must agree with M5-T170's emitted envelope rows on every document version (lesson iii); a mutation that disagrees fails a dedicated test.
RISK B5: expected values come ONLY from the reference cases and the law; G1 re-derives each; the GIS south offset is 35.31 (not 33.32); no unconditional coverage/placement conclusion.

RISK B6 (interface churn): if M5-T182 shipped the modules, this task consumes them read-only; if the wiring needs a different signature, re-opening placement.py/area_allocation.py is a scope correction. Folding Part A into this task (no split) removes the risk.
